Thaçi, who has maintained his innocence, may appeal the judgment; prosecutors may also challenge the outcome.

story_report.summary: Federal Reserve officials are widely expected to approve a quarter-point interest-rate increase at their September 15-16 meeting, which would be the first hike since 2023 and the first under Chair Kevin Warsh. Rising consumer and producer prices have sharpened the case for tighter policy: August consumer inflation reached 3.4% over 12 months, while producer prices rose 5.4%. A rate increase could raise some consumer and business borrowing costs, though the immediate effect on mortgages and other longer-term loans is less direct.
